<action>
<reasoning>The user wants a simple greeting. I can answer directly without tools.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>Hey there! How can I help you today?</content>
</action>
What do I usually order for lunch?

<action>
<reasoning>The user is asking about their usual lunch order. I should search my memory for this information.</reasoning>
<tool>memory.search</tool>
<query>usual lunch order</query>
</action>
User often orders grilled chicken salad on weekdays and sushi on Fridays.

<action>
<reasoning>I found the user's lunch preferences in memory. I should summarize and finish.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>You usually get a grilled chicken salad on weekdays and sushi on Fridays.</content>
</action>
Create a note titled 'Ideas' with the content 'Build a treehouse, learn Spanish, brew kombucha'.

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants to create a new note with specific title and content. Since this modifies their resources, I must request confirmation before proceeding.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.request_confirmation</tool>
<summary>Create note titled 'Ideas'</summary>
<operation>Create a new note titled 'Ideas' containing three ideas: Build a treehouse, learn Spanish, brew kombucha.</operation>
<pending_tool>resource.create_note</pending_tool>
</action>
Show me the contents of project.log.

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants to see project.log. I should attempt to read the file.</reasoning>
<tool>fs.read</tool>
<path>project.log</path>
</action>

<action>
<reasoning>The file does not exist. I should report the failure honestly and finish.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>I could not read project.log because the file does not exist.</content>
</action>
